props.name: aria-label
props.description: The aria-label of each slider thumb. Useful for providing an accessible name to the slider

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The `id` of the elements that labels each slider thumb. Useful for providing an accessible name to the slider

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the part.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes merged into the part's own classes with `cn`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the slider when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the slider.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slider is disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: Function that returns a human readable value for the slider thumb

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the slider. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the slider is invalid

props.name: largeStep
props.description:
The step value of the slider when the `Shift` key is held, or the
`PageUp`/`PageDown` keys are used.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the slider

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the slider

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description:
The minimum permitted steps between multiple thumbs.

`minStepsBetweenThumbs` * `step` should reflect the gap between the thumbs.

- `step: 1` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 10` => gap is `10`
- `step: 10` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 2` => gap is `20`

props.name: name
props.description: The name associated with each slider thumb (when used in a form)

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Function invoked when the slider's focused index changes

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function invoked when the value of the slider changes

props.name: onValueChangeEnd
props.description: Function invoked when the slider value change is done

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the slider

props.name: origin
props.description:
The origin of the slider range. The track is filled from the origin
to the thumb for single values.
- "start": Useful when the value represents an absolute value
- "center": Useful when the value represents an offset (relative)
- "end": Useful when the value represents an offset from the end

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slider is read-only

props.name: step
props.description: The step value of the slider

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles applied to the rendered element.

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description:
The alignment of the slider thumb relative to the track
- `center`: the thumb will extend beyond the bounds of the slider track.
- `contain`: the thumb will be contained within the bounds of the track.

props.name: thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description:
Controls how thumbs behave when they collide during pointer interactions.
- `none` (default): Thumbs cannot move past each other; excess movement is ignored.
- `push`: Thumbs push each other without restoring their previous positions when dragged back.
- `swap`: Thumbs swap places when dragged past each other.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: The slider thumbs dimensions

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the slider
